text: Microsoft Corporation is a technology company founded by Bill Gates and Paul Allen in 1975. The company is headquartered in Redmond, Washington and develops software, hardware, and cloud services.

text: OpenAI is an artificial intelligence research laboratory consisting of the for-profit OpenAI LP and its parent company, the non-profit OpenAI Inc. The company focuses on developing safe and beneficial AI technologies.
